title: MetaSPN Protocol: Proof of Search + Proof of Energy Saved

quai.relationship: designed to anchor receipt roots to Quai Network later
quai.onchain_policy: hashes, Merkle roots, aggregate receipt counts, and non-private settlement metadata only; never raw diary, query, AI chat, or private helper text

primitive: Minimize externalized intelligence per useful answer.

core_metrics.externalized_tokens: Tokens sent to external AI providers for a query.
core_metrics.tokens_not_externalized: Estimated baseline external tokens minus actual external tokens.
core_metrics.search_hops: Number of human/network routing hops required to resolve a request.
core_metrics.reuse_count: How many later queries reused a prior receipt, corpus item, cache entry, or helper resolution.

wallet_login_receipt.purpose: Proof that a user controlled a Quai address for MetaSPN identity, connection receipts, and future proof-of-energy-saved rebates.
wallet_login_receipt.settlement_basis: identity/provenance only; no payment or rebate unless later referenced by connection, resolution, or energy rebate receipts
wallet_login_receipt.privacy: Address and signature may be shared by the user; server-side storage must not imply investment return or expose private referral graph.

connection_receipt.purpose: Payment for creating the trusted edge by which a user entered MetaSPN.
connection_receipt.privacy: May be private or shared; public views must not expose a user's full referral graph without consent.

search_receipt.purpose: Records how a request moved through the human/network graph before resolution.
search_receipt.settlement_basis: routing credit only if the route contributes to an accepted resolution or future energy saved receipt
search_receipt.privacy: Reason text may be private; public anchors use hashes.

resolution_receipt.purpose: Records the artifact, human answer, cache hit, or corpus item that resolved a query.
resolution_receipt.settlement_basis: eligible to receive future energy rebates when reused to avoid external AI calls
resolution_receipt.privacy: Raw answer/context remains offchain unless explicitly public.

energy_saved_receipt.purpose: Proof that a query was resolved without, or with less, external AI token spend than the baseline path.
energy_saved_receipt.settlement_basis: tokens_not_externalized and cost_saved_usd; rebates payable later to credited receipts/nodes
energy_saved_receipt.privacy: Contains token/cost/accounting metadata and hashes, not raw query text by default.

energy_rebate_receipt.purpose: Payable-later credit for the people or artifacts whose context kept a query inside the system.
energy_rebate_receipt.settlement_basis: derived from one or more energy_saved_receipts
energy_rebate_receipt.privacy: Public aggregate possible; user-level settlement private by default.

anchor_receipt.purpose: Daily or periodic Merkle root over offchain receipts, designed for later Quai anchoring.
anchor_receipt.privacy: Only aggregate counts and roots are public by default.

path.description: External AI path that would normally answer this query.

validation_rules: Wallet login receipts must be signed through a Quai-compatible injected provider such as Pelagus using personal_sign over a domain-bound nonce message.
saved.tokens_not_externalized must equal max(0, baseline.estimated_input_tokens + baseline.estimated_output_tokens - actual.external_input_tokens - actual.external_output_tokens).
saved.energy_saved_units defaults to saved.tokens_not_externalized unless a later energy conversion table is published.
The sum of credited_to.share should be <= 1.0.
If actual.path is external_ai, tokens_not_externalized may still be positive only when the actual external call used fewer tokens than the baseline.
No raw private query, diary, AI chat, or helper text may be placed in a public anchor receipt.
Energy rebates are payable later and must reference one or more energy_saved_receipts.

credited_to.basis: Reusable human context resolved this query without external AI.
